evidence: Conditional kinematic tracer histories through archived, coarsely resolved CM1 air. Fixed settling drifts, no flake growth/loss or turbulent dispersion, no empirical validation.
reading_rule: All controls share releases and a 35 h analysis window within a selected active episode. Exposure integrals follow interpolated fields; field subsampling is a sensitivity, not evidence that 10 min data resolve missing variability. Time-window and height exits censor histories. Releases are selected positions, not inferred particle births or cloud onsets. Episode durations start at release; no earlier exposure is recovered. These are not complete flake lifetimes or weather frequencies. Raw per-tracer durations are retained for matched comparisons. First moist episodes retain a separate right-censor flag; minima and maxima are sampled values, not bounds on unresolved fluctuations.

units.supersaturation_integrals: dimensionless humidity excess or deficit times hours

source_register.purpose: Assess available temporal fields and calculate conditional resolved-flow exposure without a new climate run.

cm1.provenance: Every selected case retains case/build identity, control-file SHA256 and selected-field byte hashes in the result. Archives remain external under climate/crm/runs.
cm1.inspection: Read scalar GrADS layout, metadata times, grid interfaces, stationary periodic boundary flags, case forcing and restart identity. Reused the field reader and CM1 Exner conversion from turbulence.py; humidity uses the Murphy–Koop ice-saturation equation already present in flakes.py.
cm1.limitation: The selected second active window uses A28_dim5 forcing, not the separate301 K resort column. It is selected storm activity, not an occurrence sample. Explicit mixing and external nudging/advection tendencies mean kinematic tracers do not label conserved material parcels.

records.reading_rule: Global native T21 grid, sampled every 3 Earth hours. Winds are at the lowest sigma level. Surface stress is the model's downward momentum transfer; its density closure uses surface temperature and the configured dry-gas constant. Wave forcing requires an explicit surface coupling rule.

gcm.reading: The source gcm_profiles.py identifies ordinary outputs as approximately3-day means. They are appropriate for forcing/climatology and cannot recover convective particle histories. The inspected instantaneous wave products have3-hour sampling and lowest-level fields; they do not export upper-air vertical velocity and cloud water. Their raw spectral archives were not decoded again.
gcm.access: NetCDF4 header read with the already installed climate environment from the main checkout, read-only. No main-checkout file was modified; scipy could not read this HDF5-backed member. Existing .npz product metadata read directly.

prior_snow_controls.reading: Read evidence assessment and prescribed depth controls. Their persistent saturated column and total simulation duration do not supply observed particle histories; no old producer/result is changed.

source_register.rights: Only derived diagnostics, source identities and synthetic test arrays are committed. Full climate field arrays remain external; no outside paper bytes are copied.

source.selected_byte_hash_rule: SHA256 of little-endian int32 selected levels, then each field name plus NUL and selected C-order little-endian float32 bytes
source.memory: Selected source fields copied once into immutable memory; source stat and control hashes rechecked afterward

configuration.release_condition: cold, qs>=1e-5 kg/kg and RHi>=1 at original 10 min fields; sample up to the declared maximum without replacement per release, then repeat each cell for every drift. Equal sampled-cell weights are conditional on release; they are not particle number or mass weights.
configuration.interpolation: trilinear scalar-point fields, periodic x/y, linear in time; recompute T and ice humidity from interpolated theta/pressure/vapour
configuration.integration: explicit midpoint; midpoint exposure quadrature; height crossing within a step uses linear segment fraction
absent_processes: material tracking of nudging and imposed large-scale advection tendencies

eulerian.reading_rule: Spells count consecutive moist samples at fixed grid cells. Their first-to-last sampled span is not a continuous-exposure lower bound or particle residence. With no sub-frame temporal regularity assumption, positive exposure has no nonzero rigorous lower bound; unsampled dry gaps can intervene.
